searchText: Hey 👋 - Do we track services anywhere that provide the Beacon API ? Seems Alchemy does not and Infura just deprecated the API. <@881905303011086387>- Great presentation! Are the slides available? https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=ZHNrAXf3RDE great talk! I have one question (maybe silly). What is stopping the bad actor from just forging a merkle proof with the correct wallet balance and serving it to that endpoint? Thus when the user verifies, the proof is correct. Does this depend on having two RPC providers? In one of the slides you show a web3 api and a beacon chain provider. They could do that, but their fake root hash would not match the “official” root hash that you obtained via the light client protocol (from the signatures of the sync committee). the fake root hash is not being signed by the sync committee so you would not accept it as valid

excerpts.content: great talk! I have one question (maybe silly). What is stopping the bad actor from just forging a merkle proof with the correct wallet balance and serving it to that endpoint? Thus when the user verifies, the proof is correct. Does this depend on having two RPC providers? In one of the slides you show a web3 api and a beacon chain provider.

excerpts.author: etan_status
excerpts.content:
They could do that, but their fake root hash would not match the “official” root hash that you obtained via the light client protocol (from the signatures of the sync committee).

the fake root hash is not being signed by the sync committee so you would not accept it as valid
